lines.zh: 我沿着末地石的棱线游，队伍不乱。
lines.en: I swim the ridges of end stone, school in a loose line.

lines.zh: 紫颂花在头顶摇晃，我跟着它的影子走。
lines.en: Chorus flowers sway overhead; I follow their shadows.

lines.zh: 三条同伴在前，我游在最后面。
lines.en: Three of my kind lead, and I take the rear.

lines.zh: 虚空就在下方，我不敢游得太低。
lines.en: The void waits below, so I keep to the high water.

lines.zh: 我们绕过末地城的高墙，一声不响。
lines.en: We round the end city walls without a sound.

lines.zh: 我摆尾的节奏和同伴一模一样。
lines.en: My tailbeat falls into the same rhythm as theirs.

lines.zh: 这里没有水草，我就贴着紫颂根游。
lines.en: There is no kelp, so I glide along chorus roots.

lines.zh: 一小片紫颂果皮漂过，我追了两步。
lines.en: A scrap of chorus peel drifts past; I chase it two strokes.

lines.zh: 队列散开又合拢，像被风吹的紫布。
lines.en: The school opens and closes like purple cloth in wind.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，怕惊动身后的同类。
lines.en: I swim slowly, wary of startling the fish behind me.

lines.zh: 末地的水是冷的，我的鳞片收紧。
lines.en: End water runs cold, and my scales pull tight.

lines.zh: 一条同伴拐弯，整群跟着拐。
lines.en: One turns, and the whole school turns with it.

lines.zh: 我从紫颂花下穿过，捡起落下的碎屑。
lines.en: I pass under the chorus flower and take its fallen crumbs.

lines.zh: 游到岛边我就停，前面没有水了。
lines.en: At the island rim I stop; the water ends here.

lines.zh: 我贴着末地石的边缘游，避开虚空。
lines.en: I swim along the end stone edge, away from the void.

lines.zh: 紫颂果的碎片漂过来，我让开。
lines.en: A chorus fruit scrap drifts by; I swerve.

lines.zh: 整群升起来，我跟着升。
lines.en: The whole school rises and I rise with it.

lines.zh: 我绕着岛游了半圈，又回原位。
lines.en: I circle half the island and return to my place.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，等紫颂花掉东西下来。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open, waiting for the chorus flower to drop something.

lines.zh: 同伴绕着我转，我们谁也懒得动。
lines.en: My school circles me; none of us bothers to move.

lines.zh: 我悬在末地石缝上方，一动不动。
lines.en: I hang above a crack in the end stone, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 紫颂花沙沙响，我抬头听了一会儿。
lines.en: The chorus flower rustles; I tilt up and listen.

lines.zh: 我吐出一个小泡，看它飘向虚空。
lines.en: I blow a bubble and watch it drift toward the void.

lines.zh: 旁边的同类在打转，我懒得理。
lines.en: A schoolmate spins nearby, and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，让水从鳃里过。
lines.en: I roll sideways to let water run through my gills.

lines.zh: 这朵紫颂花今天什么也没给我。
lines.en: This chorus flower has given me nothing today.

lines.zh: 我数同伴的尾巴，一共四条。
lines.en: I count my schoolmates' tails: four in all.

lines.zh: 末地没有白天，我分不清时辰。
lines.en: The End has no daytime, so I cannot tell the hour.

lines.zh: 我用鳍撑住自己，免得沉下去。
lines.en: I brace with my fins so I will not sink.

lines.zh: 一块紫颂果飘过来，正好落进嘴里。
lines.en: A bit of chorus fruit floats by and lands in my mouth.

lines.zh: 同伴打了个转，我也跟着转了一圈。
lines.en: A schoolmate turns, and I turn too for no reason.

lines.zh: 我盯着虚空发呆，那下面什么也没有。
lines.en: I stare into the void; there is nothing beneath it.

lines.zh: 你身上有鱼的腥味，我盯着你的口袋。
lines.en: You smell of fish, so I am watching your pocket.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲反着光，我以为是另一朵紫颂花。
lines.en: Your armor catches the light like another chorus flower.

lines.zh: 你把桶举起来，我往后缩了一点。
lines.en: You lift the bucket, and I shrink back a little.

lines.zh: 你在岸上站着，我从水里仰头。
lines.en: You stand on the shore; I look up from the water.

lines.zh: 我绕你游了一圈，确认你不是末影人。
lines.en: I circle you once to be sure you are no enderman.

lines.zh: 你的钓线垂下来，我认得那根线。
lines.en: Your fishing line hangs down, and I know that line.

lines.zh: 你蹲在水边，我猜你在等什么。
lines.en: You crouch at the water's edge, and I guess you are waiting.

lines.zh: 你伸出手，散开的同伴又聚回来。
lines.en: You reach out; my scattered school gathers again.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进水里，我追着它跑。
lines.en: Your shadow falls into the water, and I chase it.

lines.zh: 你背后的紫颂花比我高，这不公平。
lines.en: The chorus flower behind you is taller, which is unfair.

lines.zh: 我被砍中，鳞片掉了一片。
lines.en: The blade lands and a scale comes loose.

lines.zh: 疼得我一头撞进同伴身上。
lines.en: The pain drives me into a schoolmate.

lines.zh: 我转身就跑，血在水里散开。
lines.en: I turn and run, blood spreading in the water.

lines.zh: 这一下让我鳃都合不上。
lines.en: That blow leaves my gills unable to close.

lines.zh: 我窜出去，撞到了末地石。
lines.en: I bolt and crash into end stone.

lines.zh: 伤口泡在水里，凉得发疼。
lines.en: The wound sits in cold water and aches.

lines.zh: 我游得歪了，尾巴不听使唤。
lines.en: I swim crooked; my tail will not answer.

lines.zh: 同伴围上来，又一下散开。
lines.en: The school presses close, then breaks apart.

lines.zh: 我叫不出声，只能拼命摆尾。
lines.en: I cannot cry out, so I beat my tail hard.

lines.zh: 再挨一下就撑不住了。
lines.en: One more hit and I will not hold.

lines.zh: 紫颂果的味道一飘来，我就忘了队伍。
lines.en: The smell of chorus fruit reaches me and I forget the school.

lines.zh: 你手里那点紫色碎屑，是给我的吗？
lines.en: Those purple crumbs in your hand, are they for me?

lines.zh: 我贴着水面，鼻子先到。
lines.en: I press up to the surface, nose first.

lines.zh: 同伴都跑了，只有我留下。
lines.en: My schoolmates flee, and only I stay.

lines.zh: 这果子比我捡的落屑新鲜多了。
lines.en: This fruit is fresher than the scraps I pick up.

lines.zh: 我再贴近些，就一点点。
lines.en: I come in closer, only a little.

lines.zh: 你把果子丢进水里，我立刻扑上去。
lines.en: You drop the fruit in the water and I lunge.

lines.zh: 我嘴里还留着上次紫颂果的甜。
lines.en: My mouth still holds the sweetness of the last chorus fruit.

lines.zh: 我绕着你手里的东西游了三圈。
lines.en: I circled the thing in your hand three times.

lines.zh: 别晃，晃得我更想吃。
lines.en: Stop waving it, or I will want it more.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，把我们一群撞散了。
lines.en: You step into the water and scatter the whole school.

lines.zh: 我贴着你腿滑过去，鳞片刮到你。
lines.en: I slide past your leg, scales scraping your skin.

lines.zh: 同伴被我撞歪，回头看了我一眼。
lines.en: A schoolmate bumps crooked and looks back at me.

lines.zh: 你的靴子把我顶开半格。
lines.en: Your boot shoves me aside half a block.

lines.zh: 我们挤在石缝里，谁都不肯让。
lines.en: We crowd into the crack and nobody gives way.

lines.zh: 我撞上紫颂根，弹回来撞到同伴。
lines.en: I hit a chorus root, rebound, and bump a schoolmate.

lines.zh: 你游过来带起的水流把我推开。
lines.en: The current you make pushes me off course.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我鳃都闭了。
lines.en: That knock shuts my gills for a moment.

lines.zh: 我给同伴让路，自己撞上末地石。
lines.en: I yield to a schoolmate and hit end stone myself.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我立刻窜出两格。
lines.en: You touch me and I bolt two blocks away.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的鳞片朝向那条同伴。
lines.en: I turn my brightest scales toward that one schoolmate.

lines.zh: 我们绕着紫颂根打转，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: We circle the chorus root, round and round.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴碰到我的，我没躲。
lines.en: Its tail brushes mine, and I do not pull away.

lines.zh: 紫颂花下是我们的地方，别处不去。
lines.en: Under the chorus flower is our place, nowhere else.

lines.zh: 我衔来一片果皮，放在它面前。
lines.en: I carry a piece of peel over and set it down.

lines.zh: 队伍里只剩我们两条还在转。
lines.en: Only the two of us still circle in the school.

lines.zh: 它游开，我跟上去又不敢太近。
lines.en: It swims off, and I follow without getting close.

lines.zh: 我们在末地石缝里并排停着。
lines.en: We hang side by side inside a crack of end stone.

lines.zh: 我的鳃张得很快，它看得出来。
lines.en: My gills move fast, and it can tell.

lines.zh: 等这朵花开完，我们就一起走。
lines.en: When this flower finishes blooming, we leave together.

lines.zh: 我叼起沉到水底的紫颂果。
lines.en: I take the chorus fruit that sank to the bottom.

lines.zh: 那小块掉下来的东西归我了。
lines.en: That little fallen thing belongs to me now.

lines.zh: 我用嘴推了推，确认能吃。
lines.en: I nudge it with my mouth to check it is food.

lines.zh: 同伴想抢，我一口吞了。
lines.en: A schoolmate reaches for it, so I swallow first.

lines.zh: 水底的碎屑我都会试一遍。
lines.en: I try every scrap that settles on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我一头扎下去，把果子含住。
lines.en: I dive headfirst and hold the fruit in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这是我今天捡到的第一块。
lines.en: This is the first piece I have found today.

lines.zh: 我含着它，游回队伍里。
lines.en: I keep it in my mouth and swim back to the school.

lines.zh: 你丢下来的东西，落水就算我的。
lines.en: Whatever you drop, if it sinks, it is mine.

lines.zh: 吞下去之前，我闻了闻。
lines.en: I sniff it once before swallowing.

lines.zh: 水里有血味，我转过去看。
lines.en: There is blood in the water, and I turn to look.

lines.zh: 那条小鱼比我小，我盯上了。
lines.en: That small fish is smaller than me, so I fix on it.

lines.zh: 我锁住那只在水边喝水的东西。
lines.en: I lock onto the thing drinking at the water's edge.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，我停下摆尾。
lines.en: Something moves, and I stop beating my tail.

lines.zh: 目标在石缝那头，我压低身子。
lines.en: The target is past that crack, so I flatten down.

lines.zh: 我认出了那只抓过同伴的手。
lines.en: I recognize the hand that grabbed a schoolmate.

lines.zh: 你的脚在水里，我把它当目标。
lines.en: Your feet are in the water, and I count them as prey.

lines.zh: 我看到一闪，就朝那里游。
lines.en: I see a flash and swim straight at it.

lines.zh: 有一条落单的，我离开队伍。
lines.en: One has strayed from its group, so I leave mine.

lines.zh: 我锁定了，但我不敢先动。
lines.en: I have my target, but I dare not move first.

lines.zh: 我绕着它游，等它先动。
lines.en: I circle it and wait for it to move first.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底靠近，鳍几乎不动。
lines.en: I skim the bottom with my fins almost still.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就跟着调方向。
lines.en: It shifts, and I correct my angle with it.

lines.zh: 我离它还有半格，再近一点。
lines.en: Half a block to go, so a little closer.

lines.zh: 同伴在我身后，我们包住它。
lines.en: My schoolmates are behind me, and we close around it.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的脚踝，那是最软的地方。
lines.en: I watch its ankle, the softest place.

lines.zh: 我张嘴又合上，还没到时候。
lines.en: I open my mouth and shut it; not yet.

lines.zh: 水花遮住我，正好。
lines.en: The splash hides me, which is perfect.

lines.zh: 它回过头，我立马钉在原地。
lines.en: It turns its head, and I stop dead.

lines.zh: 我一点点挤过去，不惊动它。
lines.en: I creep in slowly, making no disturbance.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的脚踝，立刻松开。
lines.en: I bite its ankle and let go at once.

lines.zh: 我用头撞它一下，然后逃。
lines.en: I butt it with my head and then flee.

lines.zh: 牙齿只刮破一点皮，够了。
lines.en: My teeth only break the skin, which is enough.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，被它甩开。
lines.en: I lunge, and it throws me off.

lines.zh: 这一口咬空了，我绕回来再咬。
lines.en: That bite missed, so I swing round for another.

lines.zh: 我咬住就不放，直到它踢水。
lines.en: I hold on until it kicks the water.

lines.zh: 同伴跟着我一起撞它。
lines.en: My schoolmates rush in alongside me.

lines.zh: 我的牙不大，但长得很密。
lines.en: My teeth are small but very close together.

lines.zh: 我撞进它怀里，又弹出来。
lines.en: I slam into its chest and bounce away.

lines.zh: 咬完我就躲回紫颂根后面。
lines.en: After biting I hide behind the chorus root.

lines.zh: 我从末地的水洼里出现，身后跟着四条。
lines.en: I appear in a pool on the end stone with four behind me.

lines.zh: 紫颂花一晃，我们一群就游了出来。
lines.en: The chorus flower sways, and our school swims out.

lines.zh: 虚空之上，我们成群地散开。
lines.en: Above the void we scatter into groups.

lines.zh: 我生在这里，水是冷的，花是紫的。
lines.en: I was born here, where water is cold and flowers purple.

lines.zh: 一出现我就找了个同伴跟着。
lines.en: As soon as I appear I pick a schoolmate to follow.

lines.zh: 末地的风把我吹进这片水里。
lines.en: The End's wind blows me into this pool.

lines.zh: 我们三五条一起，从石缝里钻出来。
lines.en: Three or five of us squeeze out of a crack.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看到紫颂花，就去蹭它的根。
lines.en: The first thing I see is a chorus flower, and I rub its root.

lines.zh: 水面很静，我们悄悄地来。
lines.en: The water is still, and we arrive quietly.

lines.zh: 队伍排好了，我游在中间。
lines.en: The school forms up, and I swim in the middle.

lines.zh: 水一下子烫了，我往深处钻。
lines.en: The water turns scalding and I dive deeper.

lines.zh: 我被甩到岸上，鳞片粘着末地石。
lines.en: I am flung onto the shore, scales stuck to end stone.

lines.zh: 我离了水，鳃只能干张着。
lines.en: Out of the water, my gills pump empty air.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻，队伍全散了。
lines.en: The blast flips me over and the school breaks apart.

lines.zh: 一支箭划开水面，扎在我旁边。
lines.en: An arrow slices the water and sticks near me.

lines.zh: 紫颂花的魔法反噬，我头晕。
lines.en: Chorus magic turns on me and my head spins.

lines.zh: 这朵花三天没掉东西了。
lines.en: This flower has dropped nothing for three days.

lines.zh: 雷落进水池，我整条鱼都麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and my whole body numbs.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下拉，摆尾也没用。
lines.en: The void pulls me down and my tail beats uselessly.
